items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And we used a Swedish trumpet player... We used him for the other trumpet, for the four trumpets.

ctx.x: And we used a Swedish trumpet player. I can't think of his name right offhand. You know, that's been years ago and I haven't seen him since. We used him for the other trumpet, for the four trumpets. Now, we rehearsed in the World's Fair site in Brussels where the World's Fair was. We rehearsed in the

American theater. It had been the American theater at the World's Fair. We rehearsed the show there and each section used to go in the room and we used to take a sheet of music and we would rehearse it and memorize it. The trumpet section would go in a room and they would memorize and the saxophone section used to go in another room and they would go over the music and memorize. And we used to see who could memorize first. Then we'd all take it out and play it together. And we memorized the whole show that way.…
